title: Library, all photos
expect: The whole synthetic library in the calendar grid. The menu's Backup section offers All Photos, Not Backed Up, Needs You and Recently Backed Up.
Tile marks: sending arrow up, received and saving clock, needs you filled triangle; saved and unknown have no mark. Receipt-based Not Backed Up still excludes received photos.
V1: plain system background fills exposed grid space and calendar transitions in light and dark; no legacy cream canvas.

actions.action: Choose a view in the menu
actions.result: The same grid narrows to that view, keeping its gestures and date groups.

actions.action: Select eligible photos and press Back Up N Photos
actions.result: Intent is saved immediately; Added to Backup replaces the toolbar action, selection ends and progress stays in Backup / Overview. Registration failure preserves selection and explains why.
